Class Q-P Freighter.name: Class Q-P Freighter
Class Q-P Freighter.description: The Class Q "Freighter" is a stealth warship designed by the Syndicate for baiting pirates with the offer of what appears to be a helpless, ordinary Container Transport. 	Inside, a layer of Interference Plating hides its military-grade equipment and a dozen combat drones secreted away in its converted cargo containers, while its faux gearing conceals extra shield emitters.

FOE: Scorpion Stun Turret.name: FOE: Scorpion Stun Turret
FOE: Scorpion Stun Turret.description: Imagine a giant catapult for ball lightnings. A enormous charge of electricity is accumulated until a ion storm erupts and is hurled into the unexpecting enemy, overloading and stupifying its circuits with such force that even shields are helpless. Though actually completely unguided, the ion ball greedily strives into the next hapless target to uncharge, creating the same impression of a fierce hunt by a barely controllable beast which already haunted our ancestors hundreds of years ago. 	The relation to scorpions is a bit far fetched. Becca Finmeccanica's Research Department was commissioned by a secret customer with the codename "The Last of the First" to design a high-velocity penetrator weapon which should cause minimal hull damage but will release a knock-out gas into the targeted ship to render the crew unconscious. This working principle was associated with scorpion stings, though the intention was of course of absolutely humane nature, namely to spare lifes. Nevertheless absurd rumours circulated around this project involving nerve gas and reptiloids. 	One way or the other, after a series of accidents with of course no deaths at all, and a rapid increase in expenditures, an internal investigation was carried out, supervised by CEO Tom Becca IX. himself. After revealing schemes of corrupt managers, the involvement of green people and tests on innocent squirrels, Becca understood how that would read in the company's annual report. After the external cleaners completed their job, the project was reassigned to chief-engineer Archie Mendes and formalized as if it has always been his. Mendes got free rule, and, well, here we are.

Etna Mining Ray.name: Etna Mining Ray
Etna Mining Ray.description: This heat ray basically melts out desired minerals from asteroids. This technology had its breakthrough only recently and is therefore more expensive than the classical mining laser, however it's significantly more effective. 	During a bath in the caldarium of the thermae in Becca Finmeccanica's main research facility, the chief engineer Achie Mendes had the inspiration that one could wash out asteroids by heat. Being overwhelmed by this spark of an idea, he jumped out without dressing, running to his laboratory nakedly and calling out "Erika! Erika!" for the company's chief technology officer. Though the work on the heat project was approved enthusiastically, contract addendum 2442 forbids Archie to use the company thermae. Instead a private office bathroom was set up.

Etna Mining Ray Turret.name: Etna Mining Ray Turret
Etna Mining Ray Turret.description: This heat ray basically melts out desired minerals from asteroids. This technology had its breakthrough only recently and is therefore more expensive than the classical mining laser, however it's significantly more effective. 	During a bath in the caldarium of the thermae in Becca Finmeccanica's main research facility, the chief engineer Achie Mendes had the inspiration that one could wash out asteroids by heat. Being overwhelmed by this spark of an idea, he jumped out without dressing, running to his laboratory nakedly and calling out "Erika! Erika!" for the company's chief technology officer. Though the work on the heat project was approved enthusiastically, contract addendum 2442 forbids Archie to use the company thermae. Instead a private office bathroom was set up.

FOE: Sekhmet Autocannon.name: FOE: Sekhmet Autocannon
FOE: Sekhmet Autocannon.description: Autocannons have continuously been developed further. This current state-of-the art model is the result of a cooperation between Delta V and the Syndicate. Named after ancient Egypt's lioness goddess of war, the Sekhmet AC is a deadly weapon in the hand of any halfway capable captain or fleet commander. Firing triple-bursts of explosive large-caliber shells which don't have to impact on the target, but trigger when being close-by, even fast and maneuverable opponents can be handled properly. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

FOE: Sekhmet Dual Autocannon.name: FOE: Sekhmet Dual Autocannon
FOE: Sekhmet Dual Autocannon.description: The dual-barrel version of the Sekhmet AC fires two alternating triple-bursts of explosive large-caliber shells, such densening the explosive projectile hail going down on the enemy. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

FOE: Mafdet Autocannon.name: FOE: Mafdet Autocannon
FOE: Mafdet Autocannon.description: Named after ancient Egypt's cheetah goddess of judgment and execution, the Mafdet AC is the long-range high-precision sibling of the Sekhmet.  Applying a highly classified technology derived from the railgun concept -- kept secret especially from their Syndicate business partners --, Delta V was able to accelerate projectiles with such force, that common explosive shells did break apart. Hence the Mafdet shoots armor-piercing shells with less explosives but a hardened case. Even a shield doesn't protect the target completely, as after impact the shells' splinters continue their way to the hull. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

FOE: Bastet Autocannon Turret.name: FOE: Bastet Autocannon Turret
FOE: Bastet Autocannon Turret.description: Named after ancient Egypt's cat goddess of protection, the Bastet AC is the turreted sibling of the Sekhmet. Originally designed mainly as a defensive weapon against fighters and interceptors, it turned out to be equally useful in attack.  Equipped with an own targeting computer, this turret not only does not need a human operator, but also allows to lead the burst-fired guided explosive shells to the target, employing the ship's sensor systems. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

FOE: Rapidfire Blaster Turret.name: FOE: Rapidfire Blaster Turret
FOE: Rapidfire Blaster Turret.description: The Rapidfire Blaster Turret was created for the defense of trading ships against fast flying attackers. By removing one of the barrels of a Blaster Turret, but keeping the same socket, the freed power capacities can be used to increase the fire rate, the projectile speed and turn rate, at lower space needs. The disadvantages of earlier dissipating energy bolts, lower accuracy, and stronger heat stress on the remaining barrel, most merchants willingly accept, as long as the Rapidfire keeps pirates long enough away till the next hyperjump.

FOE: Heavy Tractor Beam.name: FOE: Heavy Tractor Beam
FOE: Heavy Tractor Beam.description: This heavier model boasts longer range to allow slower craft a more effective collection of floating materials be it ores or drifting cargo.

FS-14 Amber.name: FS-14 Amber
FS-14 Amber.description: Recent experiments in shield technology have produced a modified structure in the core of common shield generators. By injecting hyperdrive fuel, the shield generation efficiency could be doubled. 	Keep a look at your fuel display.

FS-23 Wulfenite.name: FS-23 Wulfenite
FS-23 Wulfenite.description: Recent experiments in shield technology have produced a modified structure in the core of common shield generators. By injecting hyperdrive fuel, the shield generation efficiency could be doubled. 	Keep a look at your fuel display.

FS-41 Pyrite.name: FS-41 Pyrite
FS-41 Pyrite.description: Recent experiments in shield technology have produced a modified structure in the core of common shield generators. By injecting hyperdrive fuel, the shield generation efficiency could be doubled. 	Keep a look at your fuel display.

FS-67 Aurum.name: FS-67 Aurum
FS-67 Aurum.description: Recent experiments in shield technology have produced a modified structure in the core of common shield generators. By injecting hyperdrive fuel, the shield generation efficiency could be doubled. 	Anything beyond this size creates stability issues, but works are in progress. 	Keep a look at your fuel display.

FOE: Laser Sight.name: FOE: Laser Sight
FOE: Laser Sight.description: A long range laser that does almost no damage but is used for target acquisition instead. Initially should have also the side effect to partly blind an opponent's optical tracking systems, but well, that did not work out because of things breaking the fourth wall if explaining them.

Slave.name: Slave
Slave.description: Although considered illegal by almost every government for hundred of years, slavery is still very common on pirate and anarchist planets. A slave can replace a crew member in everything but close combat, in order to avoid giving them a chance to escape. One problem with slaves is the risk of them rebelling and taking over the ship, which can be mitigated by keeping enough standard crew to stop any insurrection with force.

Active Radar Jammer.name: Active Radar Jammer
Active Radar Jammer.description: Developed as a more effective alternative to Lovelace's design, this radar jammer requires a small amount of energy to function. It is often seen in pirate warships, where combat is frequent and missiles a constant treat.

Small Interference Emitter.name: Small Interference Emitter
Small Interference Emitter.description: This interference emitter has similar capabilities to the interference plating, utilising outfit space more efficiently at the cost of a constant energy consumption. One of these is enough to halve the chance of a successful scan.

Large Interference Emitter.name: Large Interference Emitter
Large Interference Emitter.description: The larger version of the interference emitter is quite powerful, capable of stopping roughly four out of five scan attempts alone although with the same downside of its smaller brother. Often the preferred choice of smugglers, perfect for passing through high security sectors with illegal cargo.

Javelin Pod Turret.name: Javelin Pod Turret
Javelin Pod Turret.description: A popular, although unofficial, modification to the Javelin Pod allows it to be mounted in a rotating turret mount making it much more effective. A bit more inaccurate than the base model, it is still a powerful weapon for its size and is usually mounted in the warships that lack the space for comparable energy-based weapons.

Outfit Expansion (Small).name: Outfit Expansion (Small)
Outfit Expansion (Small).description: The smaller outfit expansion allows you to sacrifice that last corner of cargo space in order to perhaps make room for one more outfit, in those situations where you need just seven more tons to install that last system. 	Unfortunately, rearranging the interior of your ship in such a fundamental way tends to interfere with its cooling systems.

Living Space Removal.name: Living Space Removal
Living Space Removal.description: Living Space Removal just gains back space occupied by Living Quarters. Crew generally despise captains using this for obvious reason. It also increases loading & unloading times with the location not being always optimal.

Marine Gear.name: Marine Gear
Marine Gear.description: Everything a space marine needs to perform his duty.

Ranger Gear.name: Ranger Gear
Ranger Gear.description: Everything a space ranger needs to fight for freedom.

Trooper Gear.name: Trooper Gear
Trooper Gear.description: Everything space troopers need to protect the property of their employer.

Extended Bunk Room.name: Extended Bunk Room
Extended Bunk Room.description: Increases the space a normal bunk room would give by half, at the cost of a higher mass and more outfit space taken up.

Sizeable Map.name: Sizeable Map
Sizeable Map.description: This data chip contains complete information on 100 systems in proximity to the system you are currently in.

Type 0 Radiant Engines.name: Type 0 Radiant Engines
Type 0 Radiant Engines.description: This engine works as both steering and a thruster, allowing smaller ships to save space on engines.

Type 5 Radiant Thruster.name: Type 5 Radiant Thruster
Type 5 Radiant Thruster.description: Created as a result of the increased need for bigger engines on their new warships, this thruster is the biggest thruster yet to be used by the Wanderers

Type 5 Radiant Steering.name: Type 5 Radiant Steering
Type 5 Radiant Steering.description: Created as a result of the increased need for bigger engines on their new warships, this steering was developed alongside the new thruster for the Wanderers warships.

Volcano Afterburner Steering.name: Volcano Afterburner Steering
Volcano Afterburner Steering.description: A steering afterburner works by dumping hyperspace fuel into your engines and igniting it, turning the ship around very quickly; but you must be careful to avoid using up so much fuel that you do not have enough left for hyperspace travel. 	This steering afterburner will only respond to your ship's normal steering controls, as it doesn't have a specific input for afterburner-assisted steering.

Caldera Afterburner Steering.name: Caldera Afterburner Steering
Caldera Afterburner Steering.description: This version of the Caldera Afterburner is designed for heavy warships, allowing otherwise slow-turning ships to keep track of a faster target. 	This steering afterburner will only respond to your ship's normal steering controls, as it doesn't have a specific input for afterburner-assisted steering.

Heavy Rocket Turret.name: Heavy Rocket Turret
Heavy Rocket Turret.description: An unholy mating of Lovelace's targeting systems and Delta V's heavy ordnance, this fearsome weapon mounts two Heavy Rocket pods on a turret, along with the associated loading mechanisms for two full-sized launchers. Able to reduce any small ship to a rapidly expanding cloud of debris from any azimuth with a single salvo, its capacity for destruction is offset only by its immense mass and slow traverse rate.

Sidewinder Missile VLS.name: Sidewinder Missile VLS
Sidewinder Missile VLS.description: As the Sidewinder Missile is maneuvrable enough that it would not benefit much from a conventional turret mount, large Sidewinder Missile systems typically take the form of space-efficient vertical launch arrays. These weapons are capable of rapidly launching many missiles in quick succession, overcoming nearly any anti-missile defense through sheer volume of fire.

Dual Mining Laser Turret.name: Dual Mining Laser Turret
Dual Mining Laser Turret.description: While asteroid miners typically prefer more nimble ships that can keep speed with asteroids, the Mining Laser Turret makes it easier for large and slow ships with spacious cargo holds to mine. 	Mining Laser Turrets are designed to be used in conjunction with asteroid scanners, as being unable to target asteroids means you have to aim the weapon manually as if it were a fixed gun.

Heavy Meteor Missile Launcher.name: Heavy Meteor Missile Launcher
Heavy Meteor Missile Launcher.description: The Meteor Missile's large warhead can spell doom for poorly-defended targets when fired in great numbers, and this multi-launcher helps with that, loading its ammunition sequentially onto a set of rails that allow a large number to be fired quickly at once. 	Reloads take a long time, but the burst-fire potential allows strike-craft pilots freedom to employ hit-and-run tactics, as opposed to streadily streaming out volleys every second from a standard missile launcher.

FOE: Barrage Missile.name: FOE: Barrage Missile
FOE: Barrage Missile.description: A small missile designed by the Republic Navy to give fighters and drones more firepower, it was purpose built to be fired in large waves, hence its name.

FOE: Barrage Storage.name: FOE: Barrage Storage
FOE: Barrage Storage.description: A safe storage for the Barrage Missiles.

FOE: Barrage Launcher.name: FOE: Barrage Launcher
FOE: Barrage Launcher.description: A fast firing launcher made for compact ships, it was designed to lay down a large amount of missile fire to overwhelm enemy countermeasures to allow stronger missiles in.

FOE: Broadsider Slug.name: FOE: Broadsider Slug
FOE: Broadsider Slug.description: A Heavy slug made primarily of Tungsten.

FOE: Broadsider Storage.name: FOE: Broadsider Storage
FOE: Broadsider Storage.description: The Broadsider makes use of large magazines for loading new shells. These magazines are loaded by a crew member in an industrial exosuit.

FOE: Broadsider.name: FOE: Broadsider
FOE: Broadsider.description: As part of the Navy's 'New Age Initiative,' the team at Geminus has developed larger and more powerful weaponry to function on their new ships. The Broadsider is one such weapon created for the Battleship and meant to hit harder than anything humanity has to offer.

Hamster Plasma Engines.name: Hamster Plasma Engines
Hamster Plasma Engines.description: As a response to the Syndicate's unified Ion engine block, Delta V designed a similarly simple component, joining components of their Chipmunk engines into one unit. The engines come in a container displaying a highly motivated hamster running so fast it breaks right through its wheel. 	Plasma engines are a bit more powerful than ion engines of the same size, but they are less energy efficient and produce more heat.

A100 Atomic Engines.name: A100 Atomic Engines
A100 Atomic Engines.description: Deep Sky joined the race for miniaturized engine systems relying heavily on marketing this compact set of atomic engines as the most reliable and compact option for both drones and fighters.

FOE: Compressed Fuel Pod.name: FOE: Compressed Fuel Pod
FOE: Compressed Fuel Pod.description: For some of their most fuel hungry outfits, the Free Worlds needed a fuel pod that would be able to store more fuel on smaller ships. The Compressed Fuel Pod does just that, but it comes at the expense of a small amount of energy to run the internal pump, and is more prone to fuel leakage and other failures.

FOE: Plasma Howitzer.name: FOE: Plasma Howitzer
FOE: Plasma Howitzer.description: The Plasma Howitzer is an experimental augmentation of the Plasma Cannon that uses strong magnets to bind together an oversized plasma projectile, before stuffing the projectile with a bit of hyperspace fuel and launching it. These projectiles are highly unstable, to the point where even a bare graze is enough to release the plasma explosion. 	To keep the magnets cooled enough to function, the weapon must directly tap from the ship's normal cooling systems.

FOE: Plasma Repeater Turret.name: FOE: Plasma Repeater Turret
FOE: Plasma Repeater Turret.description: This turret places two Plasma Repeaters on one big mount, with a creative twist: The firing clocks have been tweaked so each individual gun fires slightly faster, allowing the turret to overall more effectively saturate an area. Because of its effectiveness, the Free Worlds have restricted the sale of this weapon to its Militia only.

FOE: R0152 Naval Shield.name: FOE: R0152 Naval Shield
FOE: R0152 Naval Shield.description: Navy ships have to deal with combat more frequent and dangerous than most civilian ships will ever see. As such, the Navy utilizes these more advanced shield generators to allow even their fighters to recover quickly. 	Navy shield generators work by cycling far more power through the generator, providing an increase to space efficiency at the cost of consuming extra energy and producing heat while generating shields.

FOE: R0238 Naval Shield.name: FOE: R0238 Naval Shield
FOE: R0238 Naval Shield.description: The Navy lacks any sort of dedicated interceptor, so their shield technology skips a size of generator. These shields are capable of supporting most of the Navy's light to medium warships, providing an edge over any equivalent civilian shield generator. 	Navy shield generators work by cycling far more power through the generator, providing an increase to space efficiency at the cost of consuming extra energy and producing heat while generating shields.

FOE: R0376 Naval Shield.name: FOE: R0376 Naval Shield
FOE: R0376 Naval Shield.description: This generator is designed to service the Navy's capital ships, consuming considerable energy and potentially requiring extra cooling. However, it vastly outperforms any civilian shield generator for its size. 	Navy shield generators work by cycling far more power through the generator, providing an increase to space efficiency at the cost of consuming extra energy and producing heat while generating shields.

FOE: R0518 Naval Shield.name: FOE: R0518 Naval Shield
FOE: R0518 Naval Shield.description: This is the largest and most powerful shield generator produced for the Navy, found exclusively on Navy Auxiliaries. It is capable of outperforming virtually any other shield generator in human space, while remaining relatively affordable in terms of energy and healing requirements. 	Navy shield generators work by cycling far more power through the generator, providing an increase to space efficiency at the cost of consuming extra energy and producing heat while generating shields.

FOE: PDP016 Battery Pack.name: FOE: PDP016 Battery Pack
FOE: PDP016 Battery Pack.description: Though one of the Syndicate's main businesses is in producing and selling civilian outfits, it also produces higher quality outfits for its security forces. These batteries are quite dense, but carry far more energy than a typical human battery of the same size.

FOE: PDP032 Battery Pack.name: FOE: PDP032 Battery Pack
FOE: PDP032 Battery Pack.description: This larger battery made by the Syndicate allows a ship to store an even greater amount of energy in a compact package.

FOE: PDP064 Battery Pack.name: FOE: PDP064 Battery Pack
FOE: PDP064 Battery Pack.description: The Syndicate's largest battery stores more energy than the largest civilian battery, for twenty percent less space. It does, however, weigh substantially more than a normal battery of similar size.

FOE: Sentinel Reactor.name: FOE: Sentinel Reactor
FOE: Sentinel Reactor.description: Named for its intended use in the Vanguards and Protectors of the Syndicated Security fleet, the revolutionary Sentinel Reactor by Synatom is an enlarged breeder reactor with a powerful adaptive liquid sodium cooling system. Even when the ship is heated up maximally the reactor still provides as much energy as a breeder, but only generates the heat of a basic fission reactor. At that the compact design reduces its size by one third of the expected.

FOE: Covalent Proton Turret.name: FOE: Covalent Proton Turret
FOE: Covalent Proton Turret.description: This turreted pair of Proton Guns uses some crafty engineering to allow both guns to draw from a singular enlarged projectile generator. This allows the turret mount itself to be larger, permitting the whole assembly to turn faster than other turrets of its size. 	The shared projectile generator also has some quirks; namely, the generator is prone to power overdraw - a bug since rebranded by the Syndicate's advertising department as an intended feature, as the overdraw tends to yield surplus proton projectile mass, increasing damage on target.

Heavy Blaster Turret.name: Heavy Blaster Turret
Heavy Blaster Turret.description: Turreted version of the Heavy Blaster. While it's significantly larger than Proton Turrets it's also capable of outputting more fire power to combat larger warships.

Nuclear Missile Ammo.name: Nuclear Missile Ammo
Nuclear Missile Ammo.description: Nuclear missile as ammunition for Nuclear Missile Turret.

Nuclear Missile Turret.name: Nuclear Missile Turret
Nuclear Missile Turret.description: Nine little nukes on a rotating mount. One was fired, and then there were eight...

Particle Turret (Dual).name: Particle Turret (Dual)
Particle Turret (Dual).description: The Dual Particle Turret is a versatile weapon with long range, high accuracy, and good target tracking. It also has a high hit force which can throw small ships off course.

FOE: Heavy Particle Turret.name: FOE: Heavy Particle Turret
FOE: Heavy Particle Turret.description: The Heavy Particle Turret hammers a contrahent with such violence that even larger ships can be thrown off course. However, there is also no gun version of this weapon because there is no point to install it on smaller ships which will be rendered uncontrollable for their pilots. Mainly used by commanders who prefer to employ their capital warships as mobile battle stations.

Hesperian Toolbox.name: Hesperian Toolbox
Hesperian Toolbox.description: Hesparian is the only company from Mars which got any notability. Though its heyday is long bygone, two products are still well-known, one of them being its tools. The widely used toolbox not just simply provides compartments to store tools, but also a small diagnostical computer and all kind of connectors. 	As luck has it, many people offering their services as ship crew are actually skilled in some engineering background. Specialists among the crew require higher wages, as well as space for their equipment, but offer services not covered by regular crew members.

HTS Duct-Tape.name: HTS Duct-Tape
HTS Duct-Tape.description: Hesperian is the only vendor providing duct-tape certified for use in space. Proven emergency solution to prevent a damaged ship from falling apart. Enough duct-tape also allows to attach more weaponry. Too much duct-tape might cause cooling issues.

HTS Artisan.name: HTS Artisan
HTS Artisan.description: This Hesparian Toolset contains everything to repair a ship's hull on the fly, even while being under attack.

HTS Crafter.name: HTS Crafter
HTS Crafter.description: This Hesparian Toolset contains everything to maximize the output of the ship's shield matrix.

Hesperian Red Lager.name: Hesperian Red Lager
Hesperian Red Lager.description: Hesparian is the only company from Mars which got any notability. Though its heyday is long bygone, two products are still well-known, one of them being the Red Lager. For a can of this premium beer, spacefarers come from all known space to Mars, ready to pay a day's wage. Everybody has an other conspiracy theory, why the Red Lager was banned from sale on every other planet. 	(Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to fly a ship and operate its equipment.)
